mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_analysis (task_id, tree_id, species, image_url, marked_image_url, cut_branches, keep_branches, suggestion, confidence, is_mock, model_version, create_time) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{treeId}, #{species}, #{imageUrl}, #{markedImageUrl}, #{cutBranches}, #{keepBranches}, #{suggestion}, #{confidence}, #{isMock}, #{modelVersion}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 id, task_id, tree_id, species, image_url, marked_image_url, cut_branches, keep_branches, suggestion, confidence, is_mock, model_version, create_time FROM ai_analysis WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY id DESC
